metadata.title: Code Review Sources
metadata.description: Verified July 2026 sources for code review workflows, AI-assisted review, platform-native controls, and supporting security/quality tooling.

retired_examples.name: GitKraken Code Review Best Practices 2024
retired_examples.reason: A dated vendor blog is not a stable default source for current recommendations.

retired_examples.name: Qodo Best AI Code Review Tools 2026
retired_examples.reason: Article URL no longer resolves to a stable article target; use official docs or product docs instead.

retired_examples.name: Qodo What Is Code Review
retired_examples.reason: Article URL no longer resolves to a stable article target; use official docs or product docs instead.

retired_examples.name: ConsenSys Smart Contract Best Practices
retired_examples.reason: Historical page moved; use maintained Solidity and Trail of Bits references instead.

retired_examples.name: OpenAI Datadog Case Study
retired_examples.reason: Useful case study, but weaker than the main Codex product page for current tool-surface guidance.

foundational_guides.name: Google Engineering Practices - Code Review
foundational_guides.description: Canonical lightweight review guidance covering reviewer and author behavior.
foundational_guides.relevance: Good baseline for review scope, change size, and practical reviewer expectations.

foundational_guides.name: Microsoft Code With Engineering Playbook - Code Reviews
foundational_guides.description: Engineering playbook guidance for structured reviews and team review practices.
foundational_guides.relevance: Useful secondary baseline for pragmatic process guidance.

foundational_guides.name: Conventional Comments
foundational_guides.description: Labeling system for intent-aware review comments such as issue, suggestion, and nitpick.
foundational_guides.relevance: Helpful for consistent review tone and structure across teams and tools.

foundational_guides.name: SmartBear Best Practices for Peer Code Review
foundational_guides.description: Long-lived peer review guidance often cited for review-size and inspection-rate heuristics.
foundational_guides.relevance: Useful historical reference, but any hard thresholds should be treated as heuristics rather than policy.

security_and_quality.name: OWASP Code Review Guide
security_and_quality.description: OWASP project guidance for secure code review preparation and execution.
security_and_quality.relevance: Primary AppSec review reference for secure review methodology.

security_and_quality.name: OWASP Secure Coding Practices Quick Reference - Checklist
security_and_quality.description: Secure coding checklist covering validation, auth, cryptography, and data protection.
security_and_quality.relevance: Useful companion checklist during security-focused code review.

security_and_quality.name: GitHub Code Security - Supported Alerts in Code Scanning
security_and_quality.description: Current GitHub code scanning capability surface and alert coverage.
security_and_quality.relevance: Useful to distinguish native GitHub code scanning from broader review or SAST claims.

security_and_quality.name: Semgrep Documentation
security_and_quality.description: Docs for Semgrep rules, CI integration, and code scanning patterns.
security_and_quality.relevance: Good cross-platform static analysis reference for correctness and security review automation.

security_and_quality.name: SonarQube Server Documentation
security_and_quality.description: Current SonarQube Server docs covering quality gates and static analysis.
security_and_quality.relevance: Useful for quality-gate and scanner integration guidance.

security_and_quality.name: Snyk Documentation
security_and_quality.description: Docs for dependency, code, container, and IaC scanning workflows.
security_and_quality.relevance: Useful for supply-chain and review-adjacent security automation guidance.

platform_native_review.name: GitHub Copilot Code Review
platform_native_review.description: Official GitHub Copilot review flow for AI-generated changes and pull requests. Copilot code review moved to an agentic architecture in 2026 (tool-calling to gather repo context before commenting) and added reasoning-tier routing for complex changes; verify current tier/architecture details here rather than assuming a fixed behavior.
platform_native_review.relevance: Primary source for modern GitHub-native AI review guidance.

platform_native_review.name: GitHub Copilot Automatic Code Review
platform_native_review.description: Configuration for automatic pull request review by Copilot.
platform_native_review.relevance: Needed when discussing native AI auto-review rather than manual on-demand review.

platform_native_review.name: GitHub Repository Instructions for Copilot
platform_native_review.description: Repository and path-specific custom instructions for Copilot.
platform_native_review.relevance: Important for keeping AI review comments aligned with local conventions and generated-file boundaries.

platform_native_review.name: GitHub Configure Coding Guidelines and Excluded Content
platform_native_review.description: Guidance for coding guidelines and excluded files in Copilot code review.
platform_native_review.relevance: Useful for AI review scoping and generated-file exclusion.

platform_native_review.name: GitHub Merge Queue
platform_native_review.description: Native merge queue workflow and CI implications for GitHub repositories.
platform_native_review.relevance: Primary source for GitHub-native serialized merge automation.

platform_native_review.name: GitLab Duo in Merge Requests
platform_native_review.description: GitLab Duo features available directly in merge requests.
platform_native_review.relevance: Primary source for GitLab-native AI assistance during review.

platform_native_review.name: GitLab Custom Review Instructions
platform_native_review.description: Custom instructions for GitLab Duo code review.
platform_native_review.relevance: Needed for repository-specific review guidance on GitLab.

platform_native_review.name: GitLab Merge Request Approvals
platform_native_review.description: GitLab merge request approval workflow and reviewer controls.
platform_native_review.relevance: Primary source for required approvals on GitLab.

platform_native_review.name: Bitbucket Cloud Code Insights
platform_native_review.description: Bitbucket Cloud interface for annotations, reports, and review signals from external tools.
platform_native_review.relevance: Primary native review automation surface for Bitbucket Cloud.

third_party_ai_review.name: CodeRabbit Documentation
third_party_ai_review.description: Official CodeRabbit documentation for setup, review behavior, and platform support.
third_party_ai_review.relevance: Preferred source when discussing CodeRabbit capabilities instead of marketing pages.

third_party_ai_review.name: Qodo PR-Agent Repository
third_party_ai_review.description: Open-source PR-Agent repository. Qodo transferred project governance to an independent community organization in 2026 (new org, external maintainer); Qodo remains a sponsor but now sells a separate commercial code-review product. Re-verify the canonical repo location before citing, since it moved once already.
third_party_ai_review.relevance: Better primary source than unstable Qodo blog URLs for feature and configuration details.

third_party_ai_review.name: OpenAI Codex
third_party_ai_review.description: Official Codex product page for agentic software engineering workflows.
third_party_ai_review.relevance: Useful current source when discussing agent-based review or codebase-aware software engineering assistance.

third_party_ai_review.name: Amazon Q Developer
third_party_ai_review.description: Official Amazon Q Developer entry point for AWS developer-assistance workflows.
third_party_ai_review.relevance: Current AWS product surface to cite instead of historical CodeWhisperer or CodeGuru branding.

third_party_ai_review.name: Amazon CodeGuru Reviewer Availability Change
third_party_ai_review.description: AWS moved CodeGuru Reviewer to a maintenance lifecycle; new repository associations have not been accepted since November 7, 2025. Existing associations continue to work.
third_party_ai_review.relevance: Important legacy note so the skill does not recommend a deprecated path.

third_party_ai_review.name: Claude Code Security Review (Anthropic)
third_party_ai_review.description: Anthropic's open-source tool for automated PR security vulnerability analysis using Claude; reference for AI-assisted security review integration in CI pipelines.
third_party_ai_review.relevance: First-party Anthropic implementation of AI-powered security review — strong reference for agent-assisted code review quality gates.

third_party_ai_review.name: alibaba/open-code-review
third_party_ai_review.description: Org-backed open-source AI code review tool. Source for the pre-review deterministic file gate, size-gated planning-pass threshold, and post-loop self-refutation filter pass documented in references/deterministic-vs-llm-routing.md.
third_party_ai_review.relevance: Concrete, falsifiable hybrid deterministic/LLM routing architecture for AI review tooling; extracted as a pattern reference, not copied verbatim.

smart_contract_review.name: Solidity Security Considerations
smart_contract_review.description: Official Solidity security pitfalls and language-specific review concerns.
smart_contract_review.relevance: Primary language-level review source for Solidity contracts.

smart_contract_review.name: Trail of Bits - Building Secure Contracts
smart_contract_review.description: Maintained repository of smart contract security guidance and tools.
smart_contract_review.relevance: Good replacement for older moved smart contract best-practice pages.

mcp.name: Model Context Protocol (spec)
mcp.description: Canonical Model Context Protocol: concepts, architecture, ecosystem. The dominant 2026 pattern for connecting AI apps/agents to external tools and data.

mcp.name: MCP — Build a Server
mcp.description: Official guide to building MCP servers (exposing tools/data to AI agents). Resolve current SDK and tooling at use-time.

team_and_research.name: Swarmia - A Complete Guide to Code Reviews
team_and_research.description: Operational guidance for review process, batch size, and team behavior.
team_and_research.relevance: Useful independent reference for process design, though still secondary to official docs.

team_and_research.name: The Fearless Organization
team_and_research.description: Amy Edmondson's work on psychological safety in teams.
team_and_research.relevance: Useful support for constructive review culture and feedback style.
